title: Compatible L¹ limits on a cofinal compact exhaustion glue to an L¹_loc limit (steps 5–8 of the diagonal extraction)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝⁿ open, Q_j ⊆ ℝⁿ (j ∈ ℕ) compact sets with Q_i ⊆ Q_j for i ≤ j such that every compact K ⊆ U is contained in some Q_j. Let w_k : ℝⁿ → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ) be functions that are a.e.-strongly measurable for Lebesgue measure restricted to each Q_j, and G_j : ℝⁿ → ℝ (j ∈ ℕ) functions with every G_j integrable on Q_j and ∫⁻_{Q_j} ‖w_k(x) − G_j(x)‖ₑ dx → 0 as k → ∞ for every j. Then there is v : ℝⁿ → ℝ, locally integrable on U, with ∫⁻_K ‖w_k(x) − v(x)‖ₑ dx → 0 for every compact K ⊆ U (SimonGMT Chapter02.TendstoLocallyInL1On w v U atTop).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (Q : ℕ → Set (Rn n)) (w G : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ j, IsCompact (Q j)) → Monotone Q → (∀ K : Set (Rn n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ j, K ⊆ Q j) → (∀ j k, AEStronglyMeasurable (w k) (volume.restrict (Q j))) → (∀ j, IntegrableOn (G j) (Q j) volume) → (∀ j, Tendsto (fun k ↦ ∫⁻ x in Q j, ‖w k x - G j x‖ₑ) atTop (𝓝 0)) → ∃ v : Rn n → ℝ, LocallyIntegrableOn v U volume ∧ Chapter02.TendstoLocallyInL1On w v U atTop
